bands.Avril Lavigne: Canadian singer Avril Lavigne broke through with her 2002 album Let Go. Bite Me is the lead single from her seventh album, Love Sux.
bands.Hawthorne Heights: Hawthorne Heights come from Dayton, Ohio. This single came out in October 2022 on Pure Noise Records.
bands.Sum 41: Sum 41 are a Canadian rock band. This song first appeared on their Half Hour of Power EP.
bands.Wheatus: Wheatus released this single in 2000, taken from their self-titled debut album.
bands.Green Day: This ballad is on American Idiot, which came out in September 2004.
bands.Motion City Soundtrack: Formed in 1997, the band blends pop-punk and indie rock. This 2024 single was their first new music in about ten years.
bands.Simple Plan: Simple Plan are a Canadian rock band, and this track comes from their 2002 album No Pads, No Helmets... Just Balls.
bands.Paramore: An American rock band, Paramore included this track on their 2007 album Riot!
bands.Mayday Parade: Mayday Parade come from Tallahassee, Florida. This single arrived in July 2024 as the band neared two decades together.
bands.The Offspring: This one is on the album Smash, which came out in April 1994. It became a single in early 1995.
bands.Fall Out Boy: Released as a single in March 2007, this track comes from the album Infinity on High.
bands.Fountains Of Wayne: The song is from the 2003 album Welcome Interstate Managers.
bands.blink-182: San Diego band blink-182 put this song on their 1999 album Enema of the State.
bands.Billy Talent: This Canadian rock band included the song on their 2006 album Billy Talent II.
bands.Neck Deep: Neck Deep started out in a spare room in Wrexham, Wales. This single announced their self-titled fifth album on Hopeless Records.
bands.Jimmy Eat World: The track is from the album Bleed American, released in July 2001.
bands.Taking Back Sunday: The song came out in 2004 as the lead single from the album Where You Want to Be.
bands.Yellowcard: Yellowcard are a pop-punk band from Florida. This song was released as a single in December 2003 from their album Ocean Avenue.
bands.New Found Glory: This single arrived in March 2004 and comes from the band's fourth studio album, Catalyst.
bands.Less Than Jake: Released as a single in 1998, it is the seventh track on the album Hello Rockview.
bands.Good Charlotte: This track is from the 2007 album Good Morning Revival.
bands.All Time Low: Released in June 2009 via Hopeless Records, the song comes from the album Nothing Personal.
bands.Panic! At The Disco: An American rock band, Panic! At The Disco included this track on their 2005 album A Fever You Can't Sweat Out.
bands.The All-American Rejects: Released as a single in September 2008, it led the album When the World Comes Down.
